# Parallelogram

> A local, offline validator and mechanical fixer for LLM fine-tuning JSONL, with a Python API and stdio MCP tools for coding agents.

Install with Python 3.10+: pip install parallelogram
Runtime dependencies are typer and rich. No telemetry or dataset uploads.
Accepted formats: auto, openai-chat, sharegpt, prompt-completion, alpaca, preference.

Commands:
- parallelogram check train.jsonl --json --limit 50
- parallelogram check train.jsonl --eval eval.jsonl --json --limit 50
- parallelogram check train.jsonl --fix --dry-run --json
- parallelogram check train.jsonl --fix --output clean.jsonl --json
- parallelogram rules --json
- parallelogram report train.jsonl --json
- parallelogram mcp

Check exits: 0 no errors/warnings, 1 warnings, 2 errors/invalid arguments, 3 operational failure.
Fix exits: 0 all records emitted, 1 partial fix, 2 none emitted, 3 operational failure.
Report exit 3 means regression against --baseline.
JSON schema_version is 1. Limits bound issues, never counts; inspect issues_truncated and by_rule.
Never overwrite the input or eval set. Fix into a separate output file and recheck it.

## Documentation

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/Thatayotlhe04/Parallelogram/blob/main/cli/docs/agents.md): Python API, MCP tools, client setup and instructions to paste into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
- [JSON contract](https://github.com/Thatayotlhe04/Parallelogram/blob/main/cli/docs/json-output.md): Stable fields, counts and exit codes.
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/Thatayotlhe04/Parallelogram/blob/main/cli/README.md): Installation, formats, rules and commands.
